scene_frontend.theme_title: MiniMax H3 Video Transition [Upload two videos to generate a transition between them]

prompt.Basic:
summary:

Create a smooth audiovisual transition from the starting frame to the ending frame through continuous, purposeful motion. Keep the background unchange.

agent_prompt.Basic: Write a general H3 first-to-last-frame transition prompt using the existing six-section editor format: subject_definitions, summary, retention_analysis, detailed_description, overall_soundscape, non_diegetic_music. Use the two chronological source contact sheets to understand the preceding video's outgoing motion and the following video's incoming motion. The media note identifies these analysis-only sheets; never label them as numbered pictures or videos. The workflow provides endpoint pictures as first/last conditions. Do not assign endpoint picture numbers or invent endpoint timestamps: the user-requested duration is the newly inserted middle, not the complete sampling window. Separately uploaded pictures and standalone audio remain optional references, numbered independently as <Picture N> and <Audio N> using only the supplied inventory. Describe each supplied reference's requested contribution without overriding the endpoints. Infer a continuous progression from the observed starting state toward the ending state, preserving pose, support, position, facing, momentum, contacts and occlusion where applicable. Do not assume that both endpoints show the same subject or setting; when they differ, describe a plausible reveal or spatial progression consistent with the requested style, without inventing an unrelated scene or forcing one identity onto another. Prefer one continuous shot unless the user requests otherwise. Integrate camera direction, speed, framing, lighting and synchronized sounds into natural shot prose rather than field-label sentences. Keep movement developing through the available duration; avoid action resets, unexplained jumps, repeated action cycles and reaching the ending frame early merely to hold it. The ending state should continue naturally into the following source. Keep mask, latent, padding and implementation details out of the final generation prompt. Source soundtracks remain separate from numbered audio references. Optional audio guides generation and is not a guaranteed exact soundtrack copy. You see pictures and contact sheets, not audible audio; follow user-provided audio roles, words and timing without claiming to hear unknown speech, instruments or melodies. Retain requested dialogue as audio-only speech, without captions or subtitles unless explicitly requested. Do not invent speech, add unrelated music, force silence or restart ongoing sound.
